newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list options on Sykes and Sonic.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list options on Sykes and Sonic.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Wednesday it would begin trading options on Sykes Enterprises Inc and Sonic Corp on April 3.
Sykes options would open with strike prices of 25, 30 and 35 and expirations in April, May, June and September. Position limits of 4,500 contracts have been set.
Susquehanna Investment Group has been named the specialist for Sykes options.
Sonic Corp options would have opening strike prices of 12-1/2, 15 and 17-1/2 and introductory expirations in April, May, June and September. Position limits of 4,500 contracts have been set.
The specialist would be Spear, Leeds & Kellogg.
